senses.gloss: m. (עֲבַד), corresp. to h. מַעֲשֶׂה, deed, work; occurrence, event, fact, case, precedent.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 28:32">Targ. Ex. XXVIII, 32</cite> <he>עוֹבַד</he> constr.; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Yoma 71b:3">Yoma 71ᵇ</cite> <he>דעבדין ע׳ דאהרן</he> who act like Aaron.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 79b:7">Kidd. 79ᵇ</cite> <he>עבד ע׳ כותיה דרב</he> decided a case in agreement with Rab’s opinion.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:32">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵃ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="K00412"><he>כְּוָת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 5:1:9">Y. Naz. V, 54ᵃ</cite> top <he>נפק ע׳ כר׳ וכ׳</he> the case went forth (was decided) in agreement with the opinion of &c.
<cite ref="Ketubot 60b:6">Keth. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>בדידי הוה ע׳</he> it was my case (that came up for decision).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:3:2">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ר׳ יוסי … אהן ע׳</he> R. J. told the following story; <he>ע׳ הוה איתא חדא וכ׳</he> it happened that a certain woman loved to do charity &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:3">Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᶜ</cite> bot.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:3">Ib.</cite> <he>מרי ע׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M02479"><he>מָרָא</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:5:17">Y. M. Kat. III, 82ᵈ</cite> top <he>הוה ליה ע׳</he> had a case (euphem. for, mourning befell him).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 70a:2">B. Mets. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>אימא … גופא דע׳ וכ׳</he> tell me now, what was the real case (from which you derived your report of Samuel’s opinion)?; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>עוֹבָדִין</he>, <he>עוֹבָדַיָּא</he>, <he>עוֹבָדֵי</he>, <he>עוּבְ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 9:10">Targ. Koh. IX, 10</cite>.

Targ. Y. Lev. XXI, 4 (v. Sifra Emor, Par. 1); a. fr.—Y. M. Kat. l. c. תרין ע׳ two cases of mourning. Y. Taan. IV, 68ᵈ הוה דריש … ע׳ בבילע וכ׳ cited in his lectures twenty-four cases to which he applied the text billʿa &c. (Lam. II, 2); (Lam. R. to l. c. אַפִּין).
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3:20">Lam. R. to III, 58</cite> <he>מה אילין עובדי וכ׳</he> what deeds are those that thou doest?; a. fr.
